Cataclysm DDA http://en.cataclysmdda.com/

Cataclysm DDA is a turn based rogue-like set in north east US. There is support for both ASCII and tiles (Check the options.).

If you enjoy difficult games with a lot of depth, and survival elements. You'll love CDDA.

Fallout 1 & 2 http://store.steampowered.com/sub/45615

A lot of people are familiar with the newer games, but haven't tried the older ones. These were pioneering games for their times, and even today, are quite enjoyable. Give them a go.

Neo Scavenger http://store.steampowered.com/app/248860/

Another turn based game. This one is more simple than CDDA and with slightly more scripted events. An incredibly fun game and certainly worth a try for the interesting medical and perk system (seen in other games like Project Zomboid, CDDA).

Side note: Also check out Project Zomboid, loads of fun.
